title: Snowshoeing Adventure in the Rocky Mountains Close to Denver
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off available for an extra fee (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Snowshoes are buckled around your regular shoes; please wear warm, sturdy shoes (hiking boots recommended)
Extra socks are recommended for added warmth or for backup

Minimum numbers apply. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there is not enough passengers to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, you will be offered an alternative or full refund
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the Denver area’s winter wonderland – the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains – on a snowshoeing tour! Just 30 minutes outside Denver, Colorado’s Front Range has hundreds of trails that allow you to enjoy the wintertime wilderness (Nov to March).
